summary: Provider-neutral SMS distinguishes transactional and marketing delivery, requires consent for marketing, fingerprints phone numbers in evidence, enforces quotas and deduplicates delivery callbacks.

impacts.evidence: All durable records and policy decisions are organization/workspace scoped; global manifests/config contain no tenant payload.
Credentials and PII remain behind existing secret/privacy boundaries; evidence is minimized and raw sensitive payloads are not copied.
No existing public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is removed or changed; this task is additive.
No existing EventBus schema is removed or changed; new state/evidence is additive.
Connector SDK root Connector/Runtime remain frozen; existing capability-specific ports are reused or host-side interfaces are additive.
An expand-only tenant-scoped migration is included and old readers/writers remain compatible.
Default-deny, opaque credentials, bounded inputs and fail-closed privileged operations preserve the frozen security boundary.
Privileged or regulated writes require explicit policy/approval where applicable; read-only paths cannot escalate to writes.
Security/remote/state transitions retain bounded correlation and evidence references without uncontrolled payload copies.
Replay-safe keys and remote-authoritative reconciliation prevent duplicate side effects and silent local drift.
External callbacks/egress use typed host boundaries, verification/deduplication and no arbitrary provider networking authority.
Health, lag, retry/DLQ or remote status signals are explicit and measurable without secret-bearing logs.
All migrations are additive; capabilities/providers can be disabled while preserving evidence for later recovery.
Targeted invariant tests and final repository architecture/migration/regression gates are required.
